purpose: Visual floor fills only; original source outlines, zone labels, CAD and collision geometry remain unchanged.
compositionNote: На основном уровне цветовые маски девяти залов РГО имеют приоритет: их объединение вычтено из заливок общих зон. Исходные контуры и подписи зон сохраняются; эта композиция не согласует противоречия редакций планов. Заливки антресоли оставлены без изменений.
polygonFormat: Each zones[].polygons[] is [exteriorRing, ...holeRings] in world XZ metres. Empty polygons means no remaining visual fill.

rgo.purpose: Visual toggle only: nine schematic colours inside the source RGO route. Not room design, capacity, area or collision geometry.

pixelToWorldXZ.formula: x = xFromV[0]*pixelV + xFromV[1]; z = zFromU[0]*pixelU + zFromU[1]

rgo.method: Take the existing continuousLabelledRouteEnvelope from primary slide 2. Assign each location to the nearest of the nine source label anchors in metres (Voronoi partition), then clip to that envelope. Divider lines are schematic halfway boundaries, not source walls. No scaling to match programme areas.
rgo.uiNote: Цвета помогают различать залы. Внутренние границы условные, по подписям исходного плана.
rgo.excludedArea: Unlabelled red chamber adjacent to Pantheon is outside the named route envelope and is not assigned a hall.
rules: Do not overwrite actualRoomPolygon; it stays null.
Do not use cells as room walls, collision obstacles, capacity or net-area measurements.
Render above current actual floor or clip against CAD floor triangles to avoid painting openings.
Retain source outer contours and labels. Colour swatches in hall controls must match these colours.
Keep this independently switchable from names, source outlines, equipment and visitor simulation.
